def minimize_product(n, k, x, arr):
    # Sort the array to make it easier to decide which elements to modify
    arr.sort()
    
    # Apply k operations to the array
    for _ in range(k):
        # Find the smallest element that can be increased
        if arr[0] + x < arr[0 + 1]:
            arr[0] += x
        # Find the largest element that can be decreased
        elif arr[-1] - x > arr[-2]:
            arr[-1] -= x
        # If no significant change can be made, break the loop
        else:
            break
        # Re-sort the array after each operation
        arr.sort()
    
    return arr

# Read input
n, k, x = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))

# Get the minimized array
result = minimize_product(n, k, x, arr)

# Print the result
print(' '.join(map(str, result)))
